title: The Old Testament Is the New Testament Concealed
key_points: The Old Testament and New Testament are one book with one Author and one Redeemer.
On the Emmaus road the Lord Jesus Christ showed Himself in Moses, the prophets, and the psalms.
The law was a schoolmaster meant to bring us to Christ, not to be hugged as an end in itself.
Every Old Testament covenant, from Abraham to Jeremiah's new covenant, points forward to Him.

verse.text: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

scene.caption: One book, one Author, one Redeemer
scene.alt: An open Bible and an ancient scroll together on a path at dawn, with mountains in the distance and light breaking over the horizon.

title: Biblical Symbols and Numbers
key_points: Blood is life poured out for the guilty, from the coats of skins in Eden to the Lamb of God.
Oil marks the man anointed by the Holy Ghost for service, as with Samuel and David.
Leaven pictures corruption spreading quietly, so Scripture warns believers to beware it.
Numbers like three, seven, twelve, forty, and seventy carry consistent, God-given meaning.

verse.text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

scene.caption: God teaches with pictures, and the pictures agree
scene.alt: A chalice at the center of a table flanked by a lamp, a sheaf of grain, and a set of scales, under calm daylight.

title: Christophanies: The Angel of the LORD
key_points: The Angel of the LORD appeared to Abraham, Jacob, Moses, Joshua, and Manoah before Bethlehem.
This Person accepts worship and bears the name I AM, which no created angel ever does.
At the burning bush He declared His own name and told Moses to remove his shoes on holy ground.
In Nebuchadnezzar's furnace a fourth man walked with the three, loose and unhurt, like the Son of God.

verse.text: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

scene.caption: He did not begin at Bethlehem
scene.alt: A flame burning on the desert ground at night beneath stars and distant mountains, unconsumed.

title: Types of the Lord Jesus Christ
key_points: A type is a real person or event God shaped in advance to picture something greater coming.
Isaac carrying the wood up Moriah and the Passover lamb both portray the sacrifice of the Lord Jesus Christ.
Joseph, rejected by his brethren and raised to the throne, becomes the fullest portrait of the cross.
Melchizedek, priest without genealogy, is made like the Son of God and abides a priest continually.

verse.text: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.

scene.caption: Portraits God painted, not pictures we invented
scene.alt: A doorway on a golden hillside beneath a crown of light, with a sheaf of grain nearby and mountains behind.

title: The Gap Theory: Genesis 1:1 and 1:2
key_points: God created the earth perfect, not in vain, so its later formlessness came from judgment, not creation.
Lucifer's pride and fall, described in Isaiah and Ezekiel, brought ruin between Genesis 1:1 and 1:2.
Jeremiah 4 echoes the exact language of Genesis 1:2 to describe the effect of God's fierce anger.
The Spirit moved upon the ruined waters, and the six days restore the earth for man.

verse.text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

scene.caption: The Spirit moved upon the face of the waters
scene.alt: A dove hovering over dark storm-tossed water beneath heavy clouds, with distant thunder in the sky.

title: Daniel's Timeline and the Rebirth of Israel in 1948
key_points: Ezekiel's 390 and 40 days of lying down equal 430 years of appointed chastisement for Israel.
Subtracting the 70 years in Babylon and multiplying the remainder sevenfold gives 2,520 biblical years.
Converted to 907,200 days and then to solar years, the count runs from 536 BC to 1948.
Isaiah asked who ever heard of a nation born in a single day, and it happened on 14 May 1948.

verse.text: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

scene.caption: Not one word of His promises will fall to the ground
scene.alt: An hourglass and a six-pointed star before a distant city on the hills at dusk.

title: The Seventy Weeks: Messiah Cut Off and the Temple Fulfilled
key_points: Gabriel gave Daniel 490 years determined upon his people and the holy city.
From the 445 BC decree to rebuild Jerusalem, 483 years reach the day Messiah rode into the city.
Messiah was cut off, but not for Himself, and afterward the sanctuary was destroyed in AD 70.
The Lord Jesus Christ fulfilled the temple in His own body, and believers are now God's temple.

verse.text: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary.

scene.caption: Every day of the sixty-nine weeks came to pass
scene.alt: A scroll lying on the floor of a hall between two pillars, before a temple in the background.
